name: Fiona E.
text:
Mavi Real Estate sold our Villa in February 2025.
It was a complicated sale due to name change issues and we found them to be very helpful and very responsive in helping us and dealing with these issues. They offered great advice on various suspects of the sale.

They couldn’t have been more helpful in sorting out the administrative issues as well as liaising with the translator. It was a very friendly and professional service from start to finish. They even went as far as collecting a couple of items from the villa that had been forgotten and left behind after the sale and personally delivering them to us. They also speak excellent English and are very experienced in liaising with the Turkish land registry and all related officials.

We have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone interested in buying or selling a property.

name: Tonya V.
text: I recently purchased a villa in Kalkan over the internet through Kemal at Mavi.  I had only met Kemal once, very briefly a few months earlier while visiting the area.  Due to the pandemic, a war in Europe and other travel issues it was not possible for me to view the property before purchasing.  I was wholly dependent on Kemal and his team being responsive, honest and up to date on very recent changes in Turkish law (I needed a rental property that was also “citizenship eligible”).  With all my requirements it was VERY difficult to find a suitable property.  In fact, every other agent in the area told me I was “looking for half a needle in the haystack.”  Kemal  not only had my half needle, he helped me with so many unforeseen issues that came up along the way- too many to describe here.  Issue after unforeseen issue Kemal and his team continually acted with the utmost grace and composure.  They truly went above and beyond what anyone could ever expect from a Seller’s realtor.  I cannot recommend Kemal and his team at Mavi highly enough.

name: James & Irina .
text:
Hi Kemal,
Please see below our testimonial:
We bought our villa in Kalkan in October 2019, the first time we have purchased property in Turkey. Kemal made it a very smooth process, navigating us through the various steps to completion and always available to advise us on both the sale itself and the wider property market.

name: Nigel .
text: Kemal at Mavi was very helpful and knowledgeable about selling our apartment. Nothing was too much trouble, the sale went through very smoothly and the money was in our account in 24 hours. Would highly recommend for buying and selling your property. Thanks again Kemal.

name: Lenette & Jens Enemark
text:
We bought the house through Kemal in 2007 and sold it again through Kemal in 2019!
The sale has been a long, “bumpy” road, but we have been fully satisfied with his work and expertise, and how he handled the problems on the way!
We give Kemal our best recommendations.
